subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Which action best mitigates the likelihood of an agency inappropriately declaring an 'emergency' purchase due to poor inventory management?
options: Establishing robust term contracts, inventory tracking, and reorder points
Buying entirely from a single supplier without contracts
questions.explain: Good planning, forecasting, and having long-term cooperative or agency term contracts in place prevents artificial emergencies caused by sudden stock-outs.
